## Documentation Problem

What is missing, unclear, or incorrect?

## File/Location

Which file or section? (e.g., `docs/SETUP_GUIDE.md`, `README.md#quick-start`)

## Suggested Improvement

How should this be fixed? What should be added/changed?

## Type

- [ ] Missing content
- [ ] Incorrect/outdated
- [ ] Unclear/confusing
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Formatting issue
- [ ] Translation needed

## Checklist

- [ ] I have checked if this exists in another document
- [ ] I can contribute a fix (PR welcome)
